verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships agent harnesses (OpenCode, Claude Code), sets up a default agent on first boot, and exposes an `omarchy` CLI that agents can drive, which gives a base for scripting automations. But the only agentic flows shown are user-initiated, such as clicking a crash notification to dispatch the agent; the built-in automatic behaviors (snapshots on update, countdown reminders) are system features, not user-defined background automations. Missing for 10: any documented way to schedule or trigger agent tasks that run unattended in the background, background job or daemon configuration for automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
